title: Perfectionary
description: a small(ok medium) vanilla+ modpack that looks nice
body:
#  **Perfectionary** 
A simple (maybe not so simple) ~150 vanilla plus modpack with a focus on visuals and qol
# Main features
- ambient visuals and effects for environments
- immersive camera movement and gui effects
- many quality of life improvements
- a few new vanilla+ additions
- ~~optimization~~ lowering your performance a little bit
